reviews.comment: He is teaching a pretty hard subject but does it well. I am not the biggest fan of his course pack but it is helpful in filling in small gaps not covered by his lectures. As long as you show up to lectures and genuinely try the homeworks this is a useful course. This is also the class I have learned the most in (biased). You will need to email him.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If he is ever teaching Polymer Science (MSEN 420), take it. He's a pretty good lecturer and the homeworks are pretty easy. The tests can be challenging, but he lets you correct them. Doing a presentation instead of a final was also nice. (This isn't a review for Aero304)

Weekly homeworks that take between 3-7 hours depending on how quickly you see the solution. Sometimes it isn't 100% clear what is expected, so be willing to email for clarification. Exams were based on homework but long. Graded for the method rather than algebra. Lecture is worth the time so you don't have to read the incomplete course pack as much

Dr. Benzerga is great in a class of very difficult topics to grasp. He uses his own textbook/course pack which was partially incomplete or not fully worked out at the time of taking this which sucked. A lot of the solutions were deemed trivial which didn't help. The weekly homework was sometimes brutal but the exams aren't horrendous.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really good teacher. Covers material in detail. The course is heavy with weekly homeworks and a group project aside from the midterm and finals. Grading is fair
